chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa, from Ahmad ibn A'iz, from Al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala', who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the ritual bath (ghusl) when one visits the House (Kaaba) from Mina, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'I bathe from Mina, then I visit the House.'
ai.seo_question: When should one perform the ritual bath before visiting the Kaaba from Mina?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the practical flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the ritual purity (ghusl) required for visiting the Kaaba, specifically noting that the bath can be performed in Mina prior to departure. Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) personal practice serves as a legal precedent (sunna) demonstrating that the location of the bath is not strictly bound to the immediate vicinity of the Kaaba, provided the state of purity is maintained for the act of Ziyarah. This reflects the broader Shia emphasis on ease (yusr) in ritual obligations while maintaining the sanctity of the visit.
